stories.title: The Photo in the Ardennes
stories.description: A World War II soldier talks to the camera as the battle unfolds, in short 6-second scenes for 24fps generation.

scenes.visual_prompt: Extreme close-up of the SAME World War II infantry soldier, Elias, speaking directly to the camera. Caucasian male, mid-20s, narrow face, light stubble, small scar above left eyebrow. Frosted M1 helmet, snow on skin, intense eye contact with the lens. Smoke behind him, distant artillery flashes reflecting faintly on his face. Active WWII battlefield.
scenes.motion_prompt: locked frontal framing, very slow cinematic push-in, natural mouth and jaw movement while speaking, subtle head micro-movements, blinking, visible breath in cold air, faint micro tremor from distant artillery, snow drifting softly, light flicker from off-screen explosions
scenes.negative_prompt: text, watermark, logo, cartoon, modern gear
scenes.narration: I’m in the Ardennes right now. It’s freezing.

scenes.visual_prompt: Extreme close-up of the SAME soldier Elias still speaking to the camera, eye contact unwavering. Helmet rim frosted, cheeks dirty, breath visible. Smoke thickens behind him and flashes are closer now.
scenes.motion_prompt: slow push-in continues, subtle facial tension, natural speaking mouth movement, brief soft vibration from distant impact, snow and tiny debris drifting, light flicker intensifies, camera remains stable
scenes.negative_prompt: text, watermark, logo, cartoon, modern gear
scenes.narration: Shells keep landing out there. Every second feels like it could be the one.

scenes.visual_prompt: Medium close-up of the SAME soldier Elias crouched in a muddy trench, speaking directly to the camera. Snow melts on his uniform. Smoke rolls overhead. Sky flashes from artillery.
scenes.motion_prompt: stabilized handheld with heavy damping, gentle camera sway, natural speaking head movement, smoke surging above trench line, falling snow particles, no aggressive shake
scenes.negative_prompt: text, watermark, logo, cartoon, modern gear
scenes.narration: We’re pinned down in this trench. Bullets crack overhead.

scenes.visual_prompt: Medium close-up of Elias in the trench, still addressing the camera. Dirt on his face, jaw tight. A nearby blast lights the smoke behind him.
scenes.motion_prompt: gentle sway, subtle flinch reaction, brief light flicker, controlled micro tremor from distant blasts, natural mouth movement, camera stays centered on face
scenes.negative_prompt: text, watermark, logo, cartoon, modern gear
scenes.narration: No clear orders. Nobody even knows who’s still alive.

scenes.visual_prompt: Close-up of Elias’s gloved hands brushing snow away to reveal a worn black-and-white photograph. Trench wall blurred behind. Dust and snow fall as battle continues.
scenes.motion_prompt: tight framing on hands, subtle vibration from impacts, snow and dirt particles falling, fingers trembling from cold and stress, camera locked to subject, no sudden movement
scenes.negative_prompt: text, watermark, logo, readable writing, gore, cartoon
scenes.narration: Then I see it in the snow. A photograph.

scenes.visual_prompt: Close-up of the photograph in Elias’s hands. The image shows a smiling face but with no readable text. Dirt smudges on the edges, snow melting on paper.
scenes.motion_prompt: slow micro push-in, particles drifting, slight tremor, background smoke moving, camera stays locked on the photo
scenes.negative_prompt: text, watermark, logo, readable writing, gore, cartoon
scenes.narration: I don’t know whose it is. But they’re smiling like none of this exists.

scenes.visual_prompt: Close-up of Elias back on camera, speaking urgently. Another soldier grabs his sleeve from the side, mostly off-frame. Smoke thickens and flashes grow closer.
scenes.motion_prompt: controlled handheld framing with heavy damping, natural urgent head movement while speaking, brief soft jolt from nearby impact, smoke pressure wave in background, quickly re-stabilizes
scenes.negative_prompt: text, watermark, logo, cartoon, modern gear
scenes.narration: A guy next to me yells, stop staring. Keep your head down.

scenes.visual_prompt: Close-up of Elias as the trench shakes slightly. He looks into the camera, decision locked in his eyes. Light flashes closer, smoke surges.
scenes.motion_prompt: slow push-in, face remains centered, stronger light flicker, subtle vibration rising, breath quickens, no aggressive shake
scenes.negative_prompt: text, watermark, logo, cartoon, modern gear
scenes.narration: Before I can answer… everything changes.

scenes.visual_prompt: Medium-wide shot of Elias launching out of the trench into a snow-filled battlefield. Smoke thick, visibility low, flashes erupting around.
scenes.motion_prompt: forward sprint, aggressive handheld follow from behind and side, camera shake synced to footsteps, debris and snow blasting past lens, intermittent motion blur, no rotation

scenes.visual_prompt: Medium-wide battlefield shot: Elias sprinting through smoke while a tank silhouette advances in the distance. Snow and dirt explode from impacts.
scenes.motion_prompt: full sprint forward, heavier camera shake, brief frame judder from shockwaves, debris blasting across frame, motion blur bursts, no camera spin
scenes.narration: A tank pushes through the smoke. I run without thinking.

scenes.visual_prompt: Close-up of Elias moving forward through thinning smoke, speaking directly to the camera again. Face dirty, breath heavy, eyes steady. Dawn light starts to break through haze.
scenes.motion_prompt: slow forward drift, natural mouth movement while speaking, residual shake fading out, smoke peeling away, warm light emerging, camera stabilizes more each second
scenes.negative_prompt: text, watermark, logo, cartoon, modern gear
scenes.narration: I shove the photo inside my jacket. Not for luck.

scenes.visual_prompt: Extreme close-up of Elias facing the camera, final words. Eyes locked on lens, jaw clenched, dawn light warming his face through smoke.
scenes.motion_prompt: locked frontal framing, very slow push-in, subtle head micro-movement, breath stabilizing, light flicker fades, snow slows, camera fully stabilized by the end
scenes.negative_prompt: text, watermark, logo, cartoon, modern gear
scenes.narration: As proof. Then I keep moving. I’m not stopping here.
